visualCharacteristics: Home opening band with full-width parallax video or still behind a dark veil, pause/play disc, and caption row with hairline rule, linked title and abstract.
contentPattern: Row 1: a paragraph with the DAM video player link or a picture; row 2: heading (h1) with the slide link plus abstract paragraph(s).
usage: Use as the opening video or image hero band of a home or hub page with a linked title.
reuseGuidance: Reuse at the top of a landing page by swapping the media link and the linked title and abstract.
